_note: Per sub_sector: what the Industry agent should focus on and which news query to use. Banks and lenders are rate/credit-cycle driven; insurers and AMCs are market/flow driven; exchanges are volume driven.

bank_private.focus: RBI repo rate and liquidity, NIM trend, credit and deposit growth, asset quality (GNPA/NNPA), CASA, RBI actions or penalties on the sector
bank_private.news_query: India private banks RBI credit growth NIM

bank_small_finance.focus: RBI rate cycle, deposit cost, microfinance and unsecured-credit stress, asset quality
bank_small_finance.news_query: India small finance banks asset quality

bank_psu.focus: RBI repo rate, government recapitalisation/policy, PSU bank credit growth, treasury (bond yield) gains or losses, asset quality
bank_psu.news_query: India PSU banks credit growth NPA

housing_finance.focus: RBI repo rate pass-through, housing demand, NHB regulation, funding cost, asset quality

nbfc.focus: RBI repo rate and NBFC regulation, bank-funding cost, retail/unsecured credit stress, vehicle/gold/MSME demand, asset quality
nbfc.news_query: India NBFC RBI regulation asset quality

govt_financier.focus: Government capex and power/rail/renewable lending demand, funding cost, policy changes
govt_financier.news_query: India PFC REC IRFC IREDA lending policy

holding_investment.focus: Performance of underlying subsidiaries/investments, market levels, holding-company discount

insurance_life.focus: Premium growth, VNB margin, IRDAI regulation, GST/tax changes, bond yields and equity markets
insurance_life.news_query: India life insurance IRDAI VNB premium growth

insurance_general.focus: Premium growth, combined ratio, claims, IRDAI regulation, health and motor trends
insurance_general.news_query: India general insurance IRDAI claims combined ratio

amc_wealth.focus: SIP flows, AUM trend, equity-market level, SEBI fee/regulation changes
amc_wealth.news_query: India mutual fund AUM SIP flows SEBI

broker_exchange_infra.focus: Market volumes and turnover, F&O regulation by SEBI, retail participation, demat additions
broker_exchange_infra.news_query: India capital markets volumes SEBI F&O regulation

fintech_payments.focus: RBI payments/lending regulation, UPI policy, user growth, unit economics
fintech_payments.news_query: India fintech RBI payments regulation UPI

_financials_shared.focus: RBI repo rate, stance and liquidity (CRR/SLR), credit and deposit growth, NIM direction, asset quality (GNPA/NNPA), RBI/SEBI/IRDAI regulation, bond yields, USD/INR, FII flows and equity-market level
news_queries: India banks credit growth NIM RBI
India NBFC housing finance RBI regulation asset quality
India capital markets SEBI FPI flows insurance IRDAI
